item.title: Fall Guys Collaboration Event Returns November 6!
item.description: We are delighted to announce that the Fall Guys collaboration will be blundering back to a realm near you very soon! Join a Blunderville show and get your hands on a whole host of exquisite prizes, including fetching attire, a marvelous mount, framer's kits, and more!

item.title: Actions Taken Against In-Game RMT & Other Illicit Activities (Oct. 30)
Letter from the Producer LIVE Part LXXXIX Airs Friday, October 31
item.description: The next Letter from the Producer LIVE broadcast is set to air on Friday, October 31 at 4:00 a.m. (PDT). Don’t miss out!

item.title: Fan Festival 2026 in Anaheim: Website and Ticket Details!
item.description: We are pleased to announce the Fan Festival 2026 in Anaheim teaser website is now live! Learn about the upcoming event and get details on ticket purchases, including how players with active subscriptions can register for a chance to buy tickets ahead of general sales. We are excited to invite our Warriors of Light to celebrate with us in April! Visit the Fan Festival 2026 in Anaheim teaser website.

shu uemura x FINAL FANTASY XIV Collaboration Cosmetics Now Available!
item.description: We are pleased to announce our collaboration with shu uemura, the global cosmetic brand that began in Japan! Don't miss out on this special FFXIV-themed holiday collection designed with moogle and crystal motifs! Visit the shu uemura x FINAL FANTASY XIV collaboration special site.

item.title: Watch the Latest Episode of Duty Commenced
item.description: The latest episode of the North American Community team's Duty Commenced live show has been archived and is now available to view! Couldn't join the team live this time? No problem! The episode is available to watch below or on the official FINAL FANTASY XIV Twitch channel. In this episode, the Community team and special guest Merlin got into some PvP action and took a look at some of the All Saints’ Wake seasonal event activities. Of course, another segment of Community Commendations was shown off this episode as well!

item.title: Actions Taken Against In-Game RMT & Other Illicit Activities (Oct. 23)
"Minion Doodles" LINE Theme Now Available!
item.description: Are you ready to level up your LINE chat experience? Here's a brand-new LINE theme featuring your favorite FINAL FANTASY XIV minions! These adorable doodle-style minions are here to brighten up your everyday conversations with your friends, family, or fellow Warriors of Light!

item.title: Recovery from Network Technical Difficulties (Oct. 21)
The Ultimate FINAL FANTASY XIV Cookbook Vol. 2 Officially Released!
item.description: The Ultimate FINAL FANTASY XIV Cookbook returns in the highly anticipated Vol. 2, centered around critically acclaimed expansions Shadowbringers, Endwalker, and Dawntrail! Featuring incredible flavors from across the First, Garlemald, Thavnair, Old Sharlayan, Elpis, Tural, and even the far edges of Ultima Thule, the recipes inside this lore-rich, 192-page hardcover book offer easy-to-follow instructions and gorgeous photography. Read on for details.

item.title: Known Issues Following the Release of Patch 7.35 (Oct. 20)
Join us for Duty Commenced on October 22!
item.description: The next episode of Duty Commenced, the North American Community team's live show, is set for Wednesday, October 22. The team, along with special guest Merlin, will be delving into a plethora of PvP activities and checking out the All Saints’ Wake seasonal event! As always, there will be a showcase of the latest entries for Community Commendations and giveaways! Read on for details.

item.title: Companion App Updated (Oct. 19)
Pulse: FINAL FANTASY XIV Remix Album Vol. 2 (Deluxe Edition) Now on Sale!
item.description: It is our pleasure to announce that the Pulse: FINAL FANTASY XIV Remix Album Vol. 2 (Deluxe Edition) is now available to purchase! The collection gathers a whole host of arrangements across genres including EDM, future bass, house, techno pop, and electro swing. In addition to the ten tracks included on Sessions 1 and 2 of the Pulse: FINAL FANTASY XIV Remix Album Vol. 2, the Deluxe Edition features five brand-new arrangements for you to enjoy, including To the Edge and Endwalker! Visit the Pulse: FINAL FANTASY XIV Remix Album Vol. 2 special site to purchase.

item.title: Letter from the Producer LIVE Part LXXXIX Set for October 31
item.description: The next Letter from the Producer LIVE is part one of our introduction to the exciting new features that await in Patch 7.4!

item.title: Announcing the Winners of the Furnishing Design Contest 2025!
item.description: We are excited to reveal the winning entries of the Furnishing Design Contest 2025! Join us in admiring the innovation and finesse of our masterful Disciples of the Hand from around the globe! View the winning entries.

item.title: New Optional Items & Limited-time Sale!
item.description: New optional items will be added to the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store starting Friday, October 17 around 1:00 a.m. (PDT). We're also hosting a limited-time sale on a selection of All Saints' Wake items, so don't miss out! Visit the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store. * The items featured above will be available for purchase after the scheduled maintenance ends on Friday, October 17 around 1:00 a.m. (PDT). Please visit the News section for detailed maintenance information. * Please note that there may be a delay in the delivery of items directly after sales commence due to congestion of the delivery system.

Lali-ho, it's Kiwikopo from the Community team! o/
Autumn is here, which means that the season for all things pumpkin is upon us once more. (Who wouldn't FALL for a good slice of pumpkin pie?!) And what better way to celebrate this hauntingly delightful occasion with the return of All Saints' Wake!

item.title: New Optional Item Available!
item.description: Galatea Attire was added as an optional item to the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store as of today, Friday, October 10. Visit the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store.

item.title: All Saints' Wake Begins October 17!
item.description: The All Saints' Wake season is come once again! As if beckoned by the gentle glow of pumpkin lanterns, the Continental Circus returns to Gridania, eager to deliver a haunting helping of devilry and revelry to those who attend their grand masquerade... Read on for details.

item.title: The Lodestone Updated (Oct. 7)
Announcing the FINAL FANTASY XIV x MONSTER HUNTER WILDS Crossover Celebration Screenshot Sweepstakes!
item.description: To celebrate the FINAL FANTASY XIV x MONSTER HUNTER WILDS crossover content, we'll be holding a screenshot sweepstakes! Take a screenshot with Guardian Arkveld, with Stray Felyne, or with any of the reward items available from the event. Post your screenshot on social media and share it with us through our entry submission page for a chance to win some in-game prizes! Read the official rules for full terms and conditions and how you can enter.

item.title: FINAL FANTASY XIV Updated (Oct. 7)
FINAL FANTASY XIV: Chronicles of Light, Volume II Available Now!
item.description: It is our pleasure to announce that FINAL FANTASY XIV: Chronicles of Light, Volume II is now available to purchase! This collection contains a total of thirty short stories, including those originally published on the Lodestone as Tales from the Shadows, Tales from the Twilight, Tales from the Dawn, and Tales under the New Moon, along with four new and exclusive stories. The book features cover art and illustrations by acclaimed FINAL FANTASY artist Toshiyuki Itahana.

Greetings, everyone!
Zhexos here, trying to cool down in this summer heat. That is exactly what you can do at this year's Moonfire Faire event that is currently underway until Tuesday, August 26, 2025 at 7:59 a.m. (PDT).

Lali-ho, we went to Anime Expo!
item.description:
Hello, everyone!  
It's Ali from the FFXIV Marketing team back with another event recap! We had an amazing opportunity to come to Anime Expo this year and celebrate with Yoshi-P who was invited as a Guest of Honor! I'm also thrilled to be joined by Minaryne from the Community team who has a lovely recap of the Cosplay Gathering at Anime Expo and our Downtown Los Angeles Gathering!

item.title: Unleashed
item.description:
Voltenyne here, with the final round of lyrics from the Cruiserweight Tier!
We've finally arrived at the theme of Howling Blade! It's hard to focus on the song when you're evading his dashes and beams, so let's disengage from the fight and lock in on those lyrics!

item.title: Not Afraid
item.description:
Here's Voltenyne, coming in from the top ropes to deliver a third round of lyrics from the Cruiserweight Tier!
Time for us to go balls-to-the-wall and smash through the floor with Brute Abominator's theme! His rage has grown out of control and won't stop until he's blown away the competition!

item.title: Back to the Drawing Board
item.description:
Hey everyone, Voltenyne here!
Hope you all wore a smock, because we'll be dipping into the colorful lyrics of Sugar Riot's theme!

item.title: A Bouquet's the Way for Valentione's Day
item.description:
Lali-ho! This is Kiwikopo from the Community team~ o/
Hope you've all been staying warm (unless, of course, you're a Warrior of Light from the southern hemisphere) and that it hasn't been too chilly. The temperature here is pretty frosty and hasn't been particularly kind to my fingertips, so I'm typing this while enjoying a hearty cuppa - a guaranteed way to warm both your fingers and heart!

item.title: Mister Foxclon's Neighborhood Recap! (Dec. 2024)
item.description:
Greetings everyone, this is Voltenyne from the Community team! 
I'm back with the latest recap of Mister Foxclon's Neighborhood, the housing tour series presented by Global Community Producer Toshio "Foxclon" Murouchi! The broadcast series aims to bring attention to the wonderful housing designs created by our player community, so we hope you'll come take a look at what your fellow housing enthusiasts have been up to!
